name: Module 3: load capsules, lysis, washes, reverse transcription, wash, release - module3_v1
source: Capsule workflow: Baronas et al., Science 391, 1138 (2026), doi:10.1126/science.ady7227 (CapSeq). Chip geometry, volumes and flows are ours.
description: Runs on chip/module3_v1_translated.json. Split-and-pool barcoding is dropped, so the only step after lysis and the washes is reverse transcription with a plain poly(dT) primer: cells already carry a per-lane lipid-anchored barcode from module 1 and nothing is added here. Reverse transcription is one isothermal hold, so it runs in main_trap itself and no new chip is needed. Every volume is a multiple of the trap's volume_ul; every flow is the highest value that keeps wall shear in the trap at or below 0.01 dyn/cm2 with 15% headroom (tau = 6*mu*Q/(w*h^2), mu = 0.8e-3 Pa s, w and h from the trap size), rounded down to 0.1 uL/min. Narrow channels and the retention gap see higher shear at that flow; only the chamber is held to the ceiling. Reagent names are generic; the dwell and hold durations are round placeholders to be fitted. lysis, wash and the RT mix share reagent_in through an off-chip rotary valve, so the line needs flushing between them.

steps.note: Load the capsule suspension into the trap through the pre-filter. Capsules settle on the retention gap and the carrier leaves through the wash waste; the load is one chamber volume.
Lyse the cells in the capsules: push lysis buffer through the bed to its own dedicated waste line, which never meets the other waste. Five chamber volumes so the bed is fully exchanged.
Lysis dwell with every port capped, at room temperature, so the lysis buffer reaches the cells inside the capsules.
Wash out the lysis buffer through the retention gap to the wash waste. Several washes of several chamber volumes each, since carryover would inhibit the next step.

Fill the trap with the reverse-transcription mix, which carries a plain poly(dT) primer: no barcode and no UMI are added here, because the cells already carry their per-lane barcode from module 1. One chamber volume, so the bed is covered and no more is spent.

Reverse transcription: one isothermal hold in the trap, in the heated zone under the chamber, with every port capped. The only thermal step on this chip; the chamber is held between 4 and 50 C by its thermal zone.
Wash the reverse-transcription mix out through the retention gap to the wash waste, leaving cDNA inside the capsules.
Back-flush the trap through backflush_in: liquid pushed up through the retention gap lifts the capsules off it and sweeps them towards the capsule outlet.
Release the capsules to module 4 as one counted suspension through to_split_tree. Twice the chamber volume carries the bed out; module 4 then splits it into the sublibraries and adds the index.
